results.content: A prediction nomogram for deep venous thrombosis risk in patients undergoing primary total hip and knee arthroplasty: a retrospective study | Thrombosis Journal | Springer Nature Link. A prediction nomogram for deep venous thrombosis risk in patients undergoing primary total hip and knee arthroplasty: a retrospective study. A prediction nomogram for deep venous thrombosis risk in patients undergoing primary total hip and knee arthroplasty: a retrospective study. These factors included age, sex, body mass index (BMI), surgical site, history of malignancy, varicose vein, positive blood test, history of DVT, smoking, diabetes need insulin, hormone replacement therapy (HRT), fracture of the hip, bed for 72 h, blood transfusion, central venous catheter (CVC), leg swelling, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), Protopathy, thrombin antithrombin complex (TAT), D-dimer. Our goal was develop a clinical prediction model that could assess the risk of lower-extremity DVT in these patients. _et al._ A prediction nomogram for deep venous thrombosis risk in patients undergoing primary total hip and knee arthroplasty: a retrospective study.
